items.title: Caleb Douglas: Scores on both catches in return
items.text:
Douglas (ankle) caught two of three targets for 70 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 28-25 win over the Jets.

items.title: Malik Willis: Three total TDs in Week 7 win
items.text:
Willis completed 14 of 21 passes for 208 yards and two touchdowns while rushing six times for 39 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 28-25 win over the Jets.

items.title: Geno Smith: Three TDs not enough in Week 7
items.text:
Smith completed 23 of 30 passes for 287 yards, three touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 28-25 loss to the Dolphins. He also rushed twice for no gain and threw a successful two-point conversion.

items.title: Garrett Wilson: Season-worst performance in Week 7
items.text:
Wilson caught two of three targets for 26 yards in Sunday's 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.

items.title: Aaron Jones: Aggravates previous knee injury
items.text:
Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Jones aggravated a previous knee injury during Sunday's 16-10 win against the Colts, Ben Goessling of the Minnesota Star Tribune reports.
